svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Shelf: one flat piece of 3 mm steel plate, 118 long x 80 wide,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: laser or plasma cut. No bending.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Holes: two 5.5 mm holes, 30 apart sideways, 68 from the back edge,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: to match the rivet nuts in the top of the hoop's front bar; four

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: more to suit the scanner's own mounting holes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the shelf lies on the top of the hoop's front bar, reaching 58 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: back and 40 mm forward, with 2 mm of air over the safety edge. The

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: scanner stands on it: scan plane 173 mm above the floor, front 10 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: shelf flat and level within 1 degree; 2 mm clear of the edge.
